11.why: After the announcer's 'Apollo Control at 2 hours 25 minutes' the tape runs on through the Carnarvon pass: 'Houston through Carnarvon' (NASA 002:25:44) is heard at 10015 s and 'You are GO for TLI' (002:26:38) at 10069 s, the same offset as the piece from 10181 s (002:28:32). Placement had put 10006-10181 at 002:18:17 on one stray match.
